company.name: DirectShifts
company.shortDescription: DirectShifts is a healthcare labor marketplace, connecting healthcare workers with organizations for contract/per-diem/full time work
company.description: They've set out to modernize healthcare recruiting. They're a team of physicians and entrepreneurs who have come together to solve a major pain point facing medical professionals today. Healthcare is a noble profession that has become overburdened by loss of autonomy, administrative bloat, and an ever-increasing number of intermediaries widening the gap between patients and providers. They want to help realign the industry around its original purpose and let providers administer better care.

productsAndServices.description: A digital platform connecting healthcare workers with employers for contract, per diem, and full-time jobs across various specialties and locations.
productsAndServices.name: DirectShifts Healthcare Labor Marketplace Platform

productsAndServices.description: A mobile app that allows healthcare professionals to search jobs, manage applications, track shifts, and handle documents on the go.

productsAndServices.name: DirectShifts Document Wallet

productsAndServices.description: A staffing solution that helps healthcare organizations build and manage a pool of pre-credentialed clinicians to reduce reliance on costly contract staff.

productsAndServices.description: A program that rewards healthcare professionals for referring qualified candidates who complete shifts or contracts through DirectShifts.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,947,797 to $25,286,615, a 6.41x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 60 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 66 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Doximity, ShiftMed, Nomad Health.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
